TGO.note: Document does not mention the civil register.
No enrolled count or share given, only an extension of the Savanes enrolment to 13 February 2025.
Document says nothing on a number at birth.
Document does not say who operates or owns the system beyond ANID running the campaign.
No register using the ID number is named.

facts.fact: The national biometric mass enrolment campaign (e-ID Togo), launched in late November 2024 by the Agence nationale d'identification, was extended in the Savanes region to 13 February 2025 and is planned to last at least eight months, spreading to other regions.
